messages.content: "Can you help me find a multiplayer game that is compatible with my Windows 10 system, has a minimum rating of 4.0, and falls under the 'Action' genre? After that, I need to calculate the area under the curve for the mathematical function 'x^2' within the interval [0, 5] using the 'trapezoidal' method. Then, I want to know the geographic distance in kilometers from 'Los Angeles' to 'New York'. Lastly, I need to send an email to 'john.doe@example.com' with the subject 'Meeting Reminder', the body saying 'Do not forget about our meeting tomorrow at 10 AM', and carbon copy it to 'jane.doe@example.com'."

function.name: geo_distance_calculate
function.description: Calculate the geographic distance between two given locations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting location for the distance calculation.

end_location.description: The destination location for the distance calculation.

units.description: Optional. The desired units for the resulting distance ('miles' or 'kilometers'). Defaults to 'miles'.

function.name: multiplayer_game_finder
function.description: Locate multiplayer games that match specific criteria such as rating, platform compatibility, genre, etc. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The platform you want the game to be compatible with, e.g. Windows 10, PS5.

rating.description: Desired minimum game rating on a 5.0 scale.

genre.description: Desired game genre, e.g. Action, Adventure, Racing. Default is none if not provided.

function.name: send_email
function.description: Send an email to the specified email address. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

to.description: The email address to send to.

body.description: The body content of the email.

cc.description: The email address to carbon copy. Default is none if not provided.

bcc.description: The email address to blind carbon copy. Default is none if not provided.

function.name: calculate_area_under_curve
function.description: Calculate the area under a mathematical function within a given interval. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
The mathematical function as a string.

interval.description: An array that defines the interval to calculate the area under the curve from the start to the end point.

method.description: The numerical method to approximate the area under the curve. The default value is 'trapezoidal'.
